title: Senate passes new climate bill
content: The Senate voted 54-46 to pass sweeping climate legislation after weeks of debate.

title: Fed holds interest rates steady
content: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate unchanged, citing stable inflation and strong employment.

title: OpenAI launches new model
content: OpenAI announced its latest AI model with improved reasoning capabilities and lower cost.

title: Ceasefire talks resume in Middle East
content: International mediators resumed ceasefire negotiations after a brief pause in the conflict.

title: WHO warns of new virus variant
content: The World Health Organization issued guidance on a newly identified virus variant spreading across Southeast Asia.

title: Tech giants face new antitrust probe
content: Regulators announced an investigation into the market practices of several major technology companies.
